prompt: I'm building a reusable form wrapper component in Angular 21 that uses content projection. The wrapper provides a FormStateService via viewProviders so that its own template can access form state. But I need projected content (child components passed via ng-content) to NOT see this service — they should get their own instance or the parent's instance instead. Show me the form wrapper component with viewProviders, the FormStateService, and a child component that demonstrates the isolation behavior.
assertions: Uses viewProviders array (not providers) in the form wrapper component
Uses ng-content for content projection in the form wrapper template
FormStateService is injectable and demonstrates isolated state
Projected content component does NOT receive the viewProviders instance of FormStateService
Code or comments explain why viewProviders isolates from projected content
